Mod.Name: A Bowl of Cyber Fried Rice: No Pre-made Food, We Swear
Mod.Author: lapismind / 清明葬花祭
Mod.Description: Run a "freshly cooked" takeout counter out of your pawn shop's back room. There is no stove: only a microwave, a tap and boxes of pre-made meal packs. Heat them, box them in fancy guochao bags, and hand them to the couriers before anyone tastes the truth.
